methodology.case_classification: clerk cause_of_action labels and clerk case-number prefixes only; exact labels counted are enumerated per table
methodology.matter_unit: distinct case_number per effective California Bar number
methodology.judgment_unit: each distinct positive explicit total-judgment entry that remains operative; vacated and superseded entries and renewals are excluded, and a later amended judgment replaces an earlier same-party award
methodology.judgment_amount: the clerk entry's explicit total judgment; principal, interest, costs, fees, damages, sanctions, and other components are not added to that total; separate judgment entries in one case remain separate
methodology.judgment_attribution: role-neutral case association; each accepted California attorney associated with a case receives each counted judgment entry in that case once, so attorney totals must not be summed across attorneys and are not net recoveries or enforceable balances
methodology.category_selection: each topic assigns every matched case to one mutually exclusive clerk cause_of_action category, or its case-number prefix when cause_of_action is blank
methodology.firm_affiliation: State Bar employer observed on the attorney profile, dated by state_bar_profile_fetched_at; court contact blocks are not used
methodology.sort: selected measure desc, recent matters desc, total matters desc, all civil matters desc, attorney name, bar number
methodology.full_topic_detail: every matched attorney is published in each topic detail_path; the main manifest keeps only a fast bootstrap per measure
